source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When your Command phase ends, if you control an objective marker and this unit is inside that objective marker's range, the marker stays under your control until, at the end of some phase, the opposing player has a higher **Level of Control** over it than you.

detail.condition: unit within range of an objective marker you control

effect.until: opponent's Level of Control over it exceeds yours at the end of a phase
